QF.id: AIFM CIII Legal Documents and Negotiations_33

question.text: In the PPM's Track Record section, historical performance of the fund over 6 months / 1 year / 3 years / 5 years is SPECIFICALLY applicable to:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 9.5 Box 9.1 Section VI lists the historical-track-record period '(applicable for Category III AIFs)' — 6m/1y/3y/5y. This aligns with liquid-fund performance norms; Cat I/II use IRR/MOIC/DPI/RVPI/TVPI which are drawdown-fund metrics. **The Trap:** Options A, B are Cat I/II which do not use horizon-based percentage returns. Option D is an invented sub-category. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-D tests Cat I/II track-record fields (IRR/MOIC/TVPI/DPI/RVPI). XIX-E is Cat III and uses horizon-based performance. XIX-C covers both lists. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Report Track Record in annualised terms, gross and net of fees separately — Cat III sophisticated investors back out the HWM-adjusted net quickly and mis-aligned gross-only reporting erodes credibility.
